description: RetrievedChunk: see $defs/RetrievedChunk. One chunk of the clinic handbook found for a question (M2-08), for the ask-the-clinic agent (M2-09). A citation is `doc_id = section_id`, `chunk_id = <section_id>#<chunk_no>`. The handbook is fictional and holds no patient data. Research prototype; synthetic data only.

RetrievedChunk.description: A handbook chunk with how each retrieval mode ranked it. Ranks, not raw scores, decide the hybrid order (reciprocal rank fusion).

section_id.description: The section's stable id, the same in every language (e.g. visitors.hours).

chunk_no.description: 0 for a whole section; a long section is split at paragraph breaks into 0, 1, ...

dense_cosine.description: Cosine similarity to the question; null when the dense search did not return the chunk.

bm25_rank.description: Rank in the keyword (BM25) search; null when it did not return the chunk.

rrf_score.description: Reciprocal rank fusion: the sum of 1/(60 + rank) over the modes that returned the chunk.

examples.title: Visiting hours
examples.body: Visitors are welcome from 10:00 to 21:00 every day.
